summary: Added godot/scripts/core/save_owner_construction.gd implementing the Construction owner1 (16-column) section-4 borrowed-view validation bridge per CONSTRUCTION-S4-VALIDATE-R01v2 / ADR 0186. Exactly four preloads (Construction, Schema, Section, SaveHeader); all other immutable sources (Catalog, BuildingDefinitions, EntityDirectory, Columns) are reached only through Construction's existing aliases. Implements the seven frozen gates in order: null record -> Section.REFUSE_SHAPE; wrong owner -> Sect
